violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED CHICKEN WINGS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC DISCARDED OF CHICKEN WINGS DURING INSPECTION AND INFORMED EHS CHICKEN WINGS WILL NOT BE PARTIALLY COOKED AGAIN IN THE FUTURE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT LETTUCE AT 54F, ARUGULA AT 55F, GARLIC BREAD AT 57F, COOKED BEETS AT 50F, SLICED HAM AT 53F, AND GOAT CHEESE AT 49F IN THE RIGHT 1- DOOR UPR COOLER IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND ALL FOODS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR COLD HOLDING FOODS UNTIL THIS COOLER CAN MAINTAIN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR OF THE DAIRY WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUN.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED RIGHT 1-DOOR UPR COOLER IN BACK KITCHEN BETWEEN 58-60F. OBSERVED BOTH DISHWASHING MACHINES NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. BUILDING ENGINEER CAME DURING INSPECTION AND BEGAN TO WORK ON COOLER. PIC CALLED REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION FOR THE DISHWASHING MACHINES AND THREE-VAT SINK WAS SET UP. FACILITY WILL WASH ALL DISHWARE IN THE THREE-VAT SINK UNTIL IT CAN SANITIZE PROPERLY. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF OF CORRECTION TO THE EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC PURCHASED THERMO-PLATE DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the BLEACH chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC PURCHASED A BLEACH TEST KIT DURING THE INSPECTION. WASHINGTON DULLES MARRIOTT (Inspection Date: 05/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 136.4F AND BAR DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS NEITHER DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD BE USED TO SANITIZE DISHWARE UNTIL IT CAN MEET 160F/CHLORINE IS OBSERVED BETWEEN 50-200PPM. PLEASE SEND EHS PROOF OF REPAIR AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINKS IN BACK KITCHEN MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 81F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC CONTACTED BUILDING ENGINEER DURING INSPECTION TO WORK ON FIXING THE WATER TEMPERATURE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS CAN MEET 100F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET A MAXIUM TEMPERATURE OF 150.1F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL HAVE THE BUILDING ENGINEER LOOK AT THE DISHWASHING MACHINE AS WELL. PLEASE DO NOT USE TO SANITIZE DISH-WARE UNTIL IT IS MEETING 160F OR ABOVE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THE THREE-VAT SINK MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 87F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC CONTACTED BUILDING ENGINEER DURING INSPECTION TO FIX THE WATER TEMPERATURE. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC PURCHASED APPROVED SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE INSTALL AS SOON AS IT IS RECEIVED.
